items.summary: Legal/compliance disposition: blocked for SearchWoot public beta or full launch; conditional for ordinary reversible growth that preserves existing consent, disclosures, provenance, claims, platform-policy, and data-handling boundaries. Evidence: Woot API access is documented, but no rights permit storage, derivatives, public display, caching, alerts, affiliate use, or advertising; public terms restrict relevant uses. Human counsel is required before rights-dependent launch, monetization, or external outreach. Keep the product private and preview-only.

Compliance and data-quality review: the compliance scan is a technical baseline only, with 36 pass, 17 fail, and 6 unknown; open findings include banner, consent accept/reject, GA4, privacy, and terms checks. Analytics quality is yellow because some GA4/GSC permissions or collectors fail. Revenue evidence is limited to 2026-09-21 aggregate Amazon commission of $4.92 that is not site-attributable. Do not treat incomplete telemetry as zero or as legal clearance.

Launch-readiness tracking remains active: 0 of 4 tasks closed and 4 open. Existing official API, terms, support, repository/configuration, privacy, cookie-policy, and draft-terms artifacts show progress but do not satisfy task deliverables. Exact decision: keep private; do not send rights outreach or close tasks. Next evidence action: attach one consolidated read-only bundle containing the field-level rights matrix, deployed data-flow and retention table, log/vendor/incident inventory, consent and GA4 configuration evidence, accuracy/freshness controls, and rollback evidence.

Complete the next evidence action for the active launch-readiness workstream: produce and attach a read-only bundle covering Woot field rights, deployed data flow, retention, deletion/correction/access, notification behavior, log fields, vendor terms/DPA coverage, incident/request procedures, consent withdrawal, GA4 settings, accuracy/freshness, and rollback. Do not enable tracking, change configuration, expand alerts, or send outreach.

Keep complicated.work, deadlymaracas.com, and driveford.net parked, private, and preview-only. No public launch, build admission, DNS change, analytics configuration, monetization, spend, dependency addition, or queue entry is cleared. Next evidence action: attach a dated readiness packet for complicated.work covering brief, provenance-safe content seed, compliance, security, owner, measurement boundary, rollback, and explicit blocker.
